# AEVORUN
> Learned Temporal Test-Scenario Prioritization (Model: AEVORUN-T1)

Find the time-related tests your code is most likely to need.

- Website: https://aevorun.pages.dev
- Repository: https://github.com/A35-777/AEVORUN
- Model: AEVORUN-T1 (Deep Residual MLP, 53,711 parameters, 0.07 ms CPU inference)
- License: Apache-2.0

## Capabilities
1. Extracts 82 structural AST features without invoking remote LLMs.
2. Predicts calibrated scenario relevance across 14 canonical temporal edge cases.
3. Ranks tests with 93.7% Recall@3 and 0.8760 Macro-F1 on held-out repositories.
4. Generates zero false positives (0.0% FPR) on non-temporal mathematical functions.
